services.withRest: How it fits with the rest

web.title: Websites & Apps · iDone Technologies
web.description: Marketing websites, web apps, mobile apps and platforms built by engineers. Fast, maintainable and connected to your business systems.
web.lead: We build sites and systems the way you build a product: a short spec, an architecture that holds, code you can maintain. No templates that break in a month.
included: Marketing websites and landing pages, bilingual when you need them
Web apps, admin panels and internal tools
Mobile apps (Android and iOS) built on web technology
Platforms with users, payments and permissions
Performance, accessibility and SEO as part of the build, not an add-on
forWhom: A business that needs a site that actually brings calls, not just looks good
A service company that runs on spreadsheets and needs a real system
A founder with a product idea who wants an engineering team, not an agency
web.withRest: A site is where the lead lands. We connect its forms to your CRM and WhatsApp on day one, and the videos we produce live on it and in your ads. One team, one plan.

faq.a: Whatever serves the goal. For most marketing sites we build custom with a static framework: faster, safer, cheaper to host. For apps and platforms it's custom code, always.
You do. You get the repository, documentation and a handover session.

faq.q: How long does a site take?
faq.a: A landing page, brand site or basic marketing site: a few days up to a week. Apps, complex sites and systems: it depends on the scope and complexity. We scope first, then give you a real timeline.
Yes. Monitoring, updates and small changes, on a monthly plan or per request.

video.title: Social Video Production · iDone Technologies
video.description: Reels, brand films and ads for social media. Scripting, AI-assisted footage, motion graphics and editing, in Hebrew and English.
video.lead: Reels, brand films and ads that people watch to the end. We write, produce and edit, and we use generative tools for footage, music and voice where they make the result better, not cheaper-looking.
included: Reels and stories for Instagram, TikTok and Facebook
Paid ads in multiple versions for testing
AI-generated footage, music and voice-over when it serves the story
Every video delivered in Hebrew and English if you need both
forWhom: A business that posts regularly and needs a steady supply of reels
An agency that wants a production partner for its clients
A product launching an app or a feature
video.withRest: Because we also build the app or the site, we show the real product in the video, not a mock-up. And because we build automation, the video's traffic lands in a flow that answers within seconds.

faq.a: We can, and we also produce with generated footage when a shoot is not needed. We tell you upfront which fits.

faq.q: How fast can you turn a reel around?
faq.a: Depends on the concept. A single reel from an approved script is usually days, not weeks.
We deliver the files and the post text. Posting stays with you, so your account stays yours.

automation.title: Business Automation · iDone Technologies
automation.description: Business process automation, WhatsApp chatbots, CRM and system integrations built by software engineers with n8n, Make and custom code.
automation.lead: Repetitive work that your systems should be doing for you: leads, documents, invoices, reminders, reports. We connect what you already have and write code where off-the-shelf tools stop.
included: Lead handling: form to CRM to WhatsApp to the sales rep, in seconds
WhatsApp and web chatbots that answer, qualify and log
CRM integrations: Fireberry, HubSpot, monday and others
Documents: quotes, contracts and digital signatures from a button
Finance: payments to invoices to accounting, with checks and alerts
Reports and dashboards that update themselves
forWhom: Law and accounting firms that need precision in documents and billing
Agencies that need leads, CRM and client reporting in sync
Service companies with field teams, inventory and logistics
Operations managers who want a system that runs 24/7 and doesn't fall over
automation.withRest: Automation is only as good as what feeds it. When we also build the site and the videos, the whole funnel is one system, with one team responsible for it.

faq.a: We work with all three and run our own n8n. We pick by cost, data sensitivity and how much custom logic you need. When a tool can't do it, we write the code.
Setup is a one-time project. Some flows need a subscription to an external tool, usually a small monthly fee. We tell you before we build.
Every flow we ship has error handling and alerts. You hear about it from us, not from your customers.

about.title: About · iDone Technologies
about.description: iDone Technologies is a studio of developers, video editors and automation engineers. Process before tools.
about.lead: iDone is a studio of developers, video editors and automation engineers. Every project gets a team, not one person doing everything. We come from software, so even a video or an automation goes through scoping, versions and testing.

values.name: Process before tools
values.text: We map the flow first and pick the tool second. The tool is replaceable; the process is yours.

values.name: We say what's possible
values.text: And what isn't. A clear no early is worth more than a slow yes.

values.name: We finish
values.text: Documented, handed over, monitored. The name is a promise.

how.name: Discovery and architecture
how.text: We map the data flow, pick the stack and design for growth before writing a line.

how.name: Build in a sandbox
how.text: No experiments on your live systems. Everything is built and tested apart from production.

how.name: Edge cases and load
how.text: What if the internet drops? What if a hundred leads arrive at once? We test it before you find out.

how.name: Launch and hyper-care
how.text: Controlled rollout, training for your team, full documentation, and a warranty period.

about.teamText: We keep the studio in the background and the work in front. If you want to know who you'll be working with, ask us on the call.
about.languages: We work in Hebrew and English.
